scope: Sweep allocations inside the OBJECTS callback for a rooted AC1024 NETWORK/GROUP/GEOMDEPENDENCY/LINE graph.

source.profile: NOD ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK -> association DICTIONARY -> NETWORK -> owned 2D constraint GROUP -> owned geometry dependency -> LINE target; the group's constraint action and inline implicit-point node reference the dependency, and the LINE has the reciprocal dependency reactor. The geometry dependency uses AcDbAssocEdgePersSubentId indices 201/202.

implementation.method: Warm and calibrate per encoding. Inject std::bad_alloc at each reached OBJECTS callback allocation; require failed whole-file publication, byte-identical destination sentinel preservation, source graph identity/target/subentity preservation, same-adapter retry, and fresh DXF typed readback of root, ownership, group references, dependency target/subentity fields, and reciprocal LINE reactor.

validation.ascii: 52/52 callback allocation offsets injected; destination and source graph preserved; same-adapter retry and typed rooted graph readback passed.
validation.binary: 50/50 callback allocation offsets injected; destination and source graph preserved; same-adapter retry and typed rooted graph readback passed.

limitations: Generated serialization and graph-closure control only; no physical producer prevalence, native constraint solving, or geometric semantics are established.
The test graph uses one LINE, one inline implicit point, and one Edge persistent-subentity profile. Other geometry targets/subentity classes and selected graph projections remain outside scope.
